rule: docs/slices/locale-1.md § 16.2 item 5 (coverage rule), for GALLERY-1 (docs/slices/gallery-1.md, ruling 2): the six site keys of the gallery block's viewer and tiles (`galleryTexts`, packages/shared/src/locale-strings.ts). They reach a page only in the `_gallery` of a gallery block (renderer prepareBlocks, the page's language); the readers are `GalleryRender` (the tile name) and `GalleryViewer` (the dialog name, the three buttons, the counter) in packages/plugins/src/gallery. Their checks render the real block (server HTML in English and Romanian, the browser states in English and Romanian) and the serving row asserts the en-US texts on the running build. `galleryCounter` and `galleryPhoto` are templates filled by `fillTemplate`; none is a count key. Checked by renderer/test/unit/locale-coverage.test.ts.

site.galleryViewer.case: Romanian page: the dialog's name, the three buttons and a tile's position name in Romanian

site.galleryClose.case: the closed viewer: a native <dialog> named by the locale text

site.galleryPrevious.case: the closed viewer: a native <dialog> named by the locale text
